DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 届出用紙の記入で、わかりにくい所がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything on the notification form that's hard to understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部屋のドアには二〇三とありますが、契約書にはＡ二〇三と書いてあるんです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ドア表示と契約書の部屋番号の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The door says 203, but the lease says A203.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the room number on the door and in the lease. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住所欄の部屋番号ですね。契約書を担当窓口で確認してもらいましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The room number in the address section, right? Let's have the relevant counter check the lease.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: Ａを省いて書いてしまったので、今ここで直してもよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出前の住所欄を訂正してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I already wrote it without the A. May I correct it here now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may correct the address section before submitting the form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ提出前ですね。訂正方法も担当者に聞いてから直すとよいですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: You haven't submitted it yet, correct? It's best to ask the staff how to correct it before making changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、このまま持っていきます。同じ家に住む妻の分も一緒に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 妻の転入届も併せて相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll take it as it is. I'd also like to ask about my wife's form; she lives in the same home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'd also like to ask about your wife's moving-in notification. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お二人で来庁されていますか。届出に必要な確認を担当者が行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have both of you come to the office? The staff will carry out the checks needed for the notification.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 妻は仕事中ですので、私が持ってきた書類で足りるか確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 不在の妻の届出に持参書類が足りるか確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: My wife is at work, so I'd like them to check whether the documents I've brought are enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask whether the documents you brought are enough for your absent wife's notification. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その点も窓口でお伝えください。現在お持ちの書類を、そのまま担当者に見てもらいましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please mention that at the counter too. Let's have the staff look at the documents you have as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部屋番号の訂正と妻の届出について、書類を見せて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部屋番号の訂正と妻の届出を担当窓口で相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the documents and ask about correcting the room number and my wife's notification.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll consult the relevant counter about the room number correction and your wife's notification. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらが住所の届出窓口です。どうぞお進みください、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: This is the address notification counter. Please go ahead. I'll leave you to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の予約票をお持ちですね。ご相談を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have your test appointment slip, correct? How can I help?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: その日に会社の研修が入ったので、検査を別の日に移せないかと思っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 研修と検査予約が重なったため変更を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Company training has been scheduled for that day, so I'm wondering whether I can move the test to another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about changing your appointment because training and the test overlap. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約内容を確認します。検査のための準備はもう始めましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check your appointment details. Have you started preparing for the test?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。ただ、前日の食事について書かれた紙を受け取っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 準備は未開始で前日の食事案内を受け取ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. But I have received a sheet about meals the day before.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you haven't started preparing and have received the instructions for meals the previous day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 日時を変える場合は、準備を始める日も確認が必要ですね。ご希望の日はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: If the appointment changes, we'll need to check when preparations should begin too. Do you have a preferred date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 研修が終わった次の週なら休めますが、午前中の枠を相談できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 研修翌週の午前の検査枠を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can take time off the week after the training ends. Could I ask about a morning slot?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request a morning test slot the week after training. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 予約担当に空きを確認してもらいます。今の予約は、変更が決まるまで取り消さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll have the booking staff check availability. Please don't cancel your current appointment until the change is confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 先に取り消さず待ちます。食事の説明は新しい予約票と一緒にもらえるでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予約を維持して待ち食事案内の再交付を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait without canceling it first. Can I get the meal instructions with the new appointment slip?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll keep your appointment while waiting, and ask for the meal instructions again. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 必要な案内を確認してお渡しします。古い紙と混ざらないよう、変更箇所も説明しますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check which instructions you need and give them to you. We'll explain what has changed so you don't mix them up with the old sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 新しい日時と準備を始める日を聞いてから、古い紙を分けて保管します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 新しい検査日時と準備開始日を確認して案内を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Once I've asked about the new date and time and when to start preparing, I'll keep the old sheet separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll check the new test date, time and preparation start date and keep the instructions separate. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では予約担当につなぎます。お気をつけて、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll connect you with the booking staff. Take care. I'll leave you with them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見つからないとのことですね。最後に見た場所から伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You can't find your bicycle, correct? First, where did you last see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 駐輪場の青い看板の横に置いたはずですが、今朝は空いていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 青い看板の横で自転車を最後に見たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm sure I left it beside the blue sign in the bicycle parking area, but the space was empty this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you last saw your bicycle beside the blue sign. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その場所に、撤去などを知らせる掲示はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Was there a notice about removal or anything similar at that spot?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 掲示には昨日の日付があります。ただ、私が停めたのは昨夜なので、対象かよくわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 撤去掲示の日付と駐輪時刻の関係が不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The notice is dated yesterday. But I parked last night, so I don't really know whether mine was included.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you're unsure how the removal notice date relates to when you parked. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 掲示を出した管理者に、対象の区画と時間を確認する必要がありますね。車体の特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: You'll need to check which section and times were covered with the manager who posted it. Does the bicycle have any distinctive features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 銀色で、後ろに子ども用の座席が付いています。座席の右側に赤いテープを貼っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車体と子ども用座席の目印を具体的に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's silver, with a child seat on the back. There's red tape on the right side of the seat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the bicycle and the identifying mark on its child seat specifically. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その特徴を記録します。防犯登録の番号がわかるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record those features. Do you have anything showing the bicycle security registration number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 番号は家の控えにあります。今は写真しかないのですが、それも見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 登録番号は自宅にあり写真の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The number is on the copy at home. I only have a photo now; could you look at that too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the registration number is at home and ask them to check the photo. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真で特徴を確認しましょう。管理者への問い合わせ結果も、次の相談の際にお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check its features in the photo. At your next consultation, please also tell us the result of your inquiry to the manager.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 区画と撤去の時刻を管理者に聞いて、登録番号の控えも用意して連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 撤去の区画と時刻を問い合わせ登録番号を準備すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask the manager which section was cleared and at what time, and get the registration number copy ready before contacting you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll ask about the removal section and time and prepare the registration number. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況がわかったら改めて伺います。お帰りはお気をつけて、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll ask you again once the situation is clearer. Take care on your way home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒に入れるものは、折っても差し支えありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is it all right to fold what you're putting in this envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 証明書の原本なので、折らずに送れる封筒を探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 証明書原本を折らずに入れる封筒を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's an original certificate, so I'm looking for an envelope that will let me send it without folding it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for an envelope that holds an original certificate without folding it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今の封筒は少し小さいですね。書類の大きさを測って、入るものを選びましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: This envelope is a little small. Let's measure the document and choose one that fits.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 中で曲がらないように厚紙を入れたいんですが、封をする前に確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 厚紙を入れた状態で封をする前の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to put cardboard in to keep it from bending inside. Could you check it before I seal it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask them to check it with the cardboard inside before sealing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、厚みや重さも含めて確認します。送り先から、発送方法の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, we'll check the thickness and weight too. Has the recipient specified a shipping method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 方法の指定はありませんが、送ったことがわかる控えを残しておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送を証明できる控えを残したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: No particular method, but I'd like to keep a record showing that I sent it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'd like to keep proof of mailing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録が残る取扱いを料金表と一緒にご説明します。配達の希望日はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll explain services that leave a record along with the price list. Do you have a preferred delivery date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来週の受付に間に合わせたいので、今送る場合の配達の目安も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 来週の提出受付に向け配達の目安を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I want it to arrive in time for submissions next week, so I'd also like an estimated delivery time if I send it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for an estimated delivery time for submission next week. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 目安を調べますが、到着日を確約できるかどうかは取扱いによって異なります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check the estimate, but whether we can guarantee an arrival date depends on the service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 料金と到着の目安を聞いてから決めます。まず書類を厚紙にはさんでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 料金と到着の目安を比較して発送方法を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll decide after hearing the price and estimated arrival. First, I'll sandwich the document between cardboard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll compare the cost and estimated arrival before choosing a shipping method. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 準備ができたらお持ちください。お待ちしております、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Bring it over when it's ready. We'll be here. I'll leave you to prepare.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 給与の受取りに使う口座のご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like advice about an account for receiving your salary, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、申込みの前に、会社の書類の名前が短く書かれていることを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与口座申込前に勤務先書類の名前省略を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Before applying, I'd like to ask about my name being shortened on my company's document.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Before applying for a salary account, ask about your shortened name on the employer's document. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人のお名前を確認できる書類と、会社の書類を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see a document confirming your name and the company's document?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 在留カードには名前が全部ありますが、会社の紙には真ん中の名前が抜けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人確認書類と勤務先書類の名前の相違を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: My residence card has my full name, but the company sheet is missing my middle name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the name difference between your identification and employer's document. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この違いを担当者に確認してもらいましょう。会社へ修正を依頼する前に、必要な表記を整理します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's have the staff check this difference. We'll establish the necessary wording before you ask the company to correct it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社には、こちらで確認してから連絡したほうがよいんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社への修正依頼前に銀行で確認する順序を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I should contact my company after checking here, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you should check with the bank before asking your company for a correction. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、口座の名義を会社へ伝える方法も、申込時に確認できます。まだ開設は決まっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. When applying, you can also check how to tell your company the account holder's name. Opening the account hasn't been confirmed yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 開設が決まるまでは、口座番号を後日知らせると会社に伝えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 口座番号を後日連絡すると勤務先へ伝える予定を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Until it's confirmed, I'll tell my company I'll give them the account number later.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you plan to tell your employer you'll provide the account number later. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのようにお伝えください。確認の結果、別の書類が必要になる場合もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please tell them that. Depending on the checks, we may need another document too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 追加で必要になった書類は、書類名を紙に書いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加書類の名称を書面で示すよう依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Could you write down the names of any additional documents I need?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the names of additional documents in writing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当者から具体的にご案内します。それではこちらへどうぞ、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff will give you specific instructions. Please come this way. I'll leave you with them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 洗剤の棚でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help at the detergent shelf?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この値札は三百円ですが、隣にある一個のボトルの値段でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 洗剤の三百円の値札が一個に対応するか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: This label says 300 yen. Is that the price of the single bottle beside it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the detergent's 300-yen label applies to one bottle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 品番を確認しますね。この札は、透明な袋に入った二個組の商品に対応しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the item number. This label is for the two-pack in a transparent bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二個合わせて三百円ということですか。一個ずつ買った場合と比べたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二個組の合計価格を確認し単品と比較したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Does that mean 300 yen for both together? I'd like to compare it with buying them individually.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the total price for the two-pack and say you want to compare it with individual bottles. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、一個の商品は二百円と表示されています。容量も見比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. The individual item is marked 200 yen. Please compare the volumes too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 札に書かれた容量は同じですね。ただ、棚には一個の商品しか残っていないようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 容量は同じだが棚に単品しかないと指摘する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The volumes on the labels are the same. But it looks as if only individual bottles are left on the shelf.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point out that the volumes match but only individual bottles are on the shelf. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二個組の在庫を確認します。急ぎでお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check the stock of two-packs. Do you need it urgently?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日の洗濯に必要なので、在庫がなければ一個だけ買って帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 当日必要なので二個組がなければ単品を買うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I need it for today's laundry, so if there are no two-packs, I'll buy just one bottle and take it home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you need it today and will buy an individual bottle if the two-pack isn't available. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認しましたが、二個組は今は品切れです。札の下に品切れの表示を付けますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've checked, and the two-pack is currently sold out. I'll put an out-of-stock notice below the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: それなら二百円の一個にします。二個組の札を見て勘違いしていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 品切れを受け二百円の単品を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll take one for 200 yen. I misunderstood after seeing the two-pack label.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After hearing it's sold out, say you'll choose the 200-yen individual bottle. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 紛らわしくて失礼しました。こちらの商品をお持ちください、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Sorry for the confusion. Please take this item. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園路の状態を知りたいですか。昨夜は雨が降りましたね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to know the condition of the park paths? It rained last night.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 靴が滑りやすいので、土の道を通らずに少し歩きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 滑りやすい靴のため土の園路を避けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My shoes are slippery, so I'd like a short walk without going on the dirt paths.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to avoid the park's dirt paths because your shoes are slippery. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 舗装された道でも、落ち葉のある所は滑ることがあります。遠くまで行く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Even paved paths can be slippery where there are fallen leaves. Are you planning to go far?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 長くは歩きません。ベンチまで行って、休んでから戻れれば十分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ベンチで休んで戻る短い散歩を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I won't walk for long. Just going to a bench, resting and returning would be enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for a short walk to rest on a bench and return. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの園路にベンチがあります。ただ、先は土の道につながっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There's a bench on this path. But beyond it, the path joins a dirt trail.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ベンチで引き返せば、土の道を通らずに済むということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ベンチで折り返せば土の道を避けられるか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: So if I turn back at the bench, I won't need to use the dirt path, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that turning back at the bench will let you avoid the dirt path. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、同じ道を戻れます。段差のある脇道へ入らないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, you can return along the same path. Please don't take the side path with changes in level.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人が別の入口で待つ予定でしたが、こちらの入口に変えてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人との待ち合わせを同じ入口へ変更すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: My friend was going to wait at a different entrance, but I'll ask them to change to this entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll move your meeting with your friend to the same entrance. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのほうが移動が少なくなりますね。待ち合わせ場所は決まりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That will mean less walking. Have you decided on a meeting place?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今いる案内板の前にします。友人に連絡してからベンチへ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内板前を集合場所にして友人に連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: In front of the information board where we are now. I'll contact my friend before heading to the bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll meet in front of the information board and contact your friend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 道の状態を見ながらお歩きください。それでは、よい散歩を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30203-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Watch the path conditions as you walk. Have a pleasant walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札の前で何かお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for something in front of the ticket gates?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さっきホームのベンチに弁当袋を置いたまま、改札を出てしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 改札を出た後にホームへ弁当袋を忘れたと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I just left my lunch bag on a platform bench and came out through the ticket gates.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: After leaving the ticket gates, report that you left your lunch bag on the platform. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのホームの、どのあたりのベンチでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which platform, and roughly which bench?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二番ホームの階段の横です。赤い袋に弁当箱と水筒が入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ベンチの位置と袋の色および中身を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Beside the stairs on platform two. It's a red bag with a lunch box and a water bottle inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the bench location, bag color and contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認しますので、改札を越えずにお待ちください。電車に置いた物ではないですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check, so please wait without going through the gates. It wasn't left on a train, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、座っていたベンチです。勝手に入り直さず、ここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車内ではなくベンチだと確認し改札外で待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Right, it was the bench where I was sitting. I'll wait here without going back in on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm it was on a bench rather than a train and wait outside the gates. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 係員が赤い袋を見つけたそうです。水筒の特徴を教えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: A staff member says they've found a red bag. Could you describe the water bottle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 銀色の水筒で、ふたに青いテープを貼っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持ち主確認のため水筒の目印を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's silver, with blue tape on the lid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the water bottle's identifying mark to confirm ownership. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 特徴が一致しています。係員がこちらへ持ってきますので、中身もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The features match. A staff member will bring it here; please check the contents too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受け取ったら弁当箱と水筒を確かめます。探してくださって助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受け取り時に弁当箱と水筒を照合すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: When I receive it, I'll check the lunch box and water bottle. Thank you for finding it; that really helps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll check the lunch box and water bottle when receiving the bag. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、係員が来るまでこちらへどうぞ。それでは、お帰りの際もお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please come over here until the staff member arrives. Take care on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の申請ですね。ご本人の証明書をお求めでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're applying for a certificate, correct? Is it your own certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同居人に頼まれた分です。本人は仕事中で、今日は来られません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人ではなく仕事中の同居人の証明書を求めると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's for my housemate, who asked me to get it. They're at work and can't come today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you're requesting a certificate for your housemate at work, not yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 証明書の種類と、代理で申請する方の関係を確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check the type of certificate and your relationship to the person you're applying for.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ住所に住んでいますが、家族ではありません。頼まれた証明書の名前は、このメモにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族ではない同居関係と証明書名のメモを提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: We live at the same address, but we're not family. The name of the certificate they asked for is on this note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you're housemates rather than family and show the note with the certificate's name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: メモを確認しますね。同居だけで代理申請できるとは限らないので、必要な手続きを調べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the note. Living together doesn't always mean you can apply on their behalf, so I'll look up the required procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 本人から電話で頼まれただけです。委任状が必要なら、今日は申請を急ぎません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 口頭依頼だけだと伝え委任が必要なら申請を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: They only asked me over the phone. If written authorization is needed, I won't rush the application today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you only have a verbal request and will postpone applying if authorization is required. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 必要書類の案内をお渡しします。本人確認についても、この案内で確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll give you instructions about the required documents. Please check the identity verification requirements in these instructions too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 本人が書く部分と私が書く部分を、案内の中で教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 委任する本人と代理人の記入欄の区別を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Could you show me which parts they fill in and which parts I fill in?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to distinguish the sections filled in by the authorizing person and the representative. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが委任する方の記入欄です。ご自身の記入欄と区別して、署名などを代わりに書かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: This is the section for the person giving authorization. Keep it separate from your own section, and don't sign or write those parts on their behalf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この案内を本人に渡します。必要な記入と持ち物がそろってから、また来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内を本人に渡し書類がそろってから再来すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll give these instructions to them. I'll come back once the required entries and things to bring are all ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll give the instructions to them and return once the documents are complete. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、不明な欄は書く前にお問い合わせください。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Ask us about any unclear fields before filling them in. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の記入で、手が止まっているところがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there a section of the medical questionnaire where you're stuck?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 飲んでいる薬の欄です。市販の薬を飲みましたが、名前を覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 市販薬を飲んだが薬名を覚えていないと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The section for medicines I'm taking. I took an over-the-counter medicine but don't remember its name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report taking an over-the-counter medicine whose name you don't remember. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: わからない名前を推測して書かなくて大丈夫です。いつ、何のために飲みましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: You don't need to guess a name you don't know. When did you take it, and what for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今朝、頭が痛くて一回飲みました。箱は家に置いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 服用した時刻と目的および箱の保管場所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Once this morning because I had a headache. The box is at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the time and purpose of taking it and where the box is. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その時刻と目的を記入して、名前は不明と書いてください。箱の写真を確認できる方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Write the time and purpose, and put “name unknown.” Is there someone who can help us check a photo of the box?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家にいる妻へ連絡できます。写真を送ってもらうまで、この欄を空けておいてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族に箱の写真を頼み記入を待てるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can contact my wife at home. May I leave this section blank until she sends a photo?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll ask family for a photo of the box and ask whether you can wait before filling it in. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: わかっていることを先に書き、名前は確認中としてください。写真が届いたら診察の際に見せましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Write what you know first and put “name being checked.” When the photo arrives, show it during your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今、写真が届きましたが、文字が小さくて読み切れません。画面のまま見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真の文字を読み切れず画面提示で確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The photo has just arrived, but the lettering is too small for me to read it all. Could you look at it on the screen?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you can't read all the lettering in the photo and ask to show the screen for checking. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、診察で画面を見せてください。飲んだ量も、わかる範囲でお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, show the screen during your consultation. Also tell the doctor how much you took, as far as you know.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一回に二錠飲んだことは覚えています。薬の写真と飲んだ時刻を医師に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 覚えている服用錠数と写真および時刻を医師に伝えると整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I remember taking two tablets that one time. I'll tell the doctor when I took it and show the medicine photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Summarize that you'll tell the doctor the number of tablets you remember, the photo and the time. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: そのようにお伝えください。それでは、お呼びするまで待合室でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-30204-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do that. Wait in the waiting room until we call you.
